title: Panda Adventure progression configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S6b progression loop (gADR-0000, gADR-0006): the data-driven leveling curve the Player levels up along, and the Drop/Pickup blockout. `level_curve` is the ordered list of cumulative EXP thresholds — entry k is the total EXP at which the Player reaches level k+2 (level 1 is the start), so the MAX level is the array's length + 1: config, never code (the gADR-0005 waves.size() idiom). That the curve is strictly increasing is a cross-field rule this schema cannot express — enforced by build_config.validate_progression_semantics before the resource derives. `drop_items` fixes the pickup COLOR for EVERY item name (the pickup SIZES and the scatter spacing migrated to scale_spec.json's pickup_sizes/pickup_spacing — gADR-0013 — composed back in by the builder) the enemies-config drop tables may reference — all three Phase-1 items are required, so a drop can never reference an unstyled item (coverage by construction, no cross-source validator). The remaining fields are the spawn/collect tween juice plus the level-up flash. Converted by scripts/build_config.py into data/generated/progression_config.tres (ProgressionConfig).

rgba.description: A color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

item_style.description: One droppable item's pickup color (gADR-0006); its box lives in scale_spec.json (gADR-0013).

asset.description: Optional view asset reference for this item's pickup block (P2-S2, #436): a res:// path or asset-pipeline id the view seam resolves; absent (or empty) renders the colored-block fallback. Authored empty until an asset slice fills it (asset references are data, gADR-0000).

level_curve.description: Cumulative EXP thresholds, one per level-up: entry k is the total EXP that reaches level k+2. Strictly increasing (enforced by build_config.validate_progression_semantics; not expressible here); the max level is length + 1 — retuning or extending the curve is a JSON-only change.

level_up_flash_color.description: Color the Player flashes to on a level-up. SUPERSEDED by the Player sprite animations (#443, gADR-0016) — a level rise now plays the sprite's 'level_up' one-shot; no longer read at runtime; retained for the editor schema forms (#441/#481).

level_up_flash_duration.description: Seconds for the level-up flash tween. SUPERSEDED by the Player sprite animations (#443, gADR-0016) — no longer read at runtime; retained for the editor schema forms (#441/#481). Strictly positive.

drop_items.description: Pickup blockout per droppable item name — the closed Phase-1 item vocabulary (gold, and the S7 Consumables bun/wine). All three are required so every item a drop table can reference has a style.

pickup_spawn_squash.description: Visual scale a spawned Pickup's block punches FROM at the moment it spawns (the gADR-0005 spawn-telegraph idiom); each component strictly positive.

pickup_spawn_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the pickup spawn squash to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.

pickup_collect_tween_duration.description: Seconds for a collected Pickup's block to tween to nothing before it frees; strictly positive.
